consequence.statement: A new optional tracing capability is added; the evidence states no operational consequence for operators who do nothing.

original.statement: Flux 2.7.0 adds OpenTelemetry tracing for Kustomization and HelmRelease reconciliation, delivered via the Provider.

decision.reason: [ev-0b599c9a3d11] lists OpenTelemetry tracing for Kustomization and HelmRelease reconciliation only as a new feature under the release highlights. It names a `Provider` as the way to use it and says nothing about existing configuration failing, being rejected or behaving differently. A new capability tied to a Provider gives an operator who does nothing no operational consequence, so "none" (informational) fits. Confidence is low because the excerpt never says outright that the feature is opt-in.
